`tsc --noEmit` stopped resolving these globals transitively through
imported source files — TS 5 let them leak across isolated-modules
boundaries, TS 6 requires each workspace's config to declare its
own globals. Rather than edit 17 tsconfigs, hoist the common set
here. Workspaces that need MORE types (@testing-library/jest-dom,
etc.) override `types` in their own tsconfig; TypeScript honors
the leaf-most value. @types/node + @types/chrome are hoisted to
